   - Relevant referrals: Face-to-face review by primary care physician arranged today.

2. Ongoing monitoring for systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE):
   - Assessment: SLE—currently on methotrexate; no specific SLE flare documented in this consult.
   - Investigations planned: Not specified in this consult.
   - Treatment planned: Continue methotrexate as prescribed.
